origin: Dated Cogent Biosciences issuer press releases. These are not original trial CSR/SAP or independent FDA filings; no claim is scientifically certified.

S01.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports the PEAK primary progression-free survival comparison: median 16.5 vs 9.2 months, HR 0.50 (95% CI 0.39–0.65), p<0.0001.
S01.unresolvedQuestion: Original protocol, blinded central review methods, censoring and locked SAP not independently inspected.

S02.sourceReportedFact: Same reported primary PFS numerical effect: 7.3-month difference in median PFS and HR 0.50.
S02.unresolvedQuestion: Clinical meaningfulness requires external context, quality-of-life and pre-specified threshold assessment.

S03.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports PFS2 HR 0.57 (95% CI 0.41–0.78), with combination median not reached vs 21 months for comparator.
S03.unresolvedQuestion: Secondary endpoint hierarchy, multiplicity and analysis definitions not reviewed.

S04.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports a PFS advantage in baseline KIT mutation subgroups.
S04.unresolvedQuestion: No independent subgroup SAP, interaction tests or complete subgroup denominators adjudicated.

S05.sourceReportedFact: Issuer estimates average combination-arm treatment duration at 21.4 months as of March 31, 2026.
S05.unresolvedQuestion: Treatment duration is not interchangeable with durability of confirmed clinical benefit; overall survival remained immature.

S17.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports treatment-related discontinuation of 7.4% in the combination arm versus 3.8% with sunitinib alone.
S17.unresolvedQuestion: Do not infer overall safety from one discontinuation category; exposure-adjusted safety and clinical consequences unreviewed.

S18.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports grade 3 or higher ALT/AST laboratory elevations in 10.8% versus 1.4% of patients.
S18.unresolvedQuestion: Potential hepatic safety imbalance requires original adverse-event tables, denominators and independent benefit-risk evaluation.

S19.sourceReportedFact: Issuer estimates mean treatment duration of 21.4 months for the combination arm.
S19.unresolvedQuestion: Mean duration alone does not establish long-term exposure-adjusted safety sufficiency.

S26.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports FDA acceptance of the combination NDA for GIST after prior imatinib and a target action date of November 30, 2026.
S26.unresolvedQuestion: Sponsor disclosure does not independently certify the FDA receipt letter, review-cycle identity or outcome.

S30.sourceReportedFact: Issuer reports priority review and earlier Breakthrough Therapy / Real-Time Oncology Review assignments.
S30.unresolvedQuestion: Designation dates, legal scope and precise FDA records require separate verification.
